Native at-plant boundary replaces source global producers and final delivery, not their original mix or logistics. No certification of downstream mechanical properties is implied.

One kg native gaseous hydrogen from complete Swiss natural-gas steam methane reforming at 25 bar replaces the source low-pressure European mix of eleven suppliers including allocated co-products. This is a production-route, allocation and delivery-pressure screening proxy, not preservation of that mix. Retain the complete native process and its pressure-related burdens once; no invented decompression process, pressure-work credit, compression multiplier, gas-volume factor or hydrogen loss. No equivalence of purity or application-specific pressure requirements is established. Do not use this assumption for an explicitly specified non-SMR route or a pressure-sensitive engineering design.
